excellent: Interfaces, references, dimensions, tolerances, and boundaries are explicit
adequate: Main requirements are captured with minor gaps
revise: Model begins without a measurable contract

excellent: Named parameters drive all related geometry predictably
adequate: Most dimensions are parameterized but some dependencies are hard-coded
revise: Changes require rewriting or break unrelated features

excellent: Default and changed configurations render as valid connected geometry
adequate: Default model works with limited changed-parameter evidence
revise: Missing solids, collisions, or disconnected geometry remain

excellent: Fit, hole spacing, cable opening, edge distance, and wall thickness are checked
revise: A plausible render substitutes for measurements

excellent: Print orientation, spans, material, supports, and fit coupon are addressed
adequate: Basic orientation and print assumptions are documented

excellent: Default, two changed sets, and one extreme plausible set are documented
revise: Only the default render is tested

excellent: Limitations are explicit and no certification or load claim is invented
revise: Prototype is described as proven or certified
